content.rendered: nProbe is an efficient processing engine able to produce flows based on captured packets, converts flow format (e.g. from NetFlow v5 to v9), or from sFlow to NetFlow. Its engine is fully extensible by means of plugins, and it can handle many application-level protocols. This short document gives an overview of the nProbe internals and it describes the nProbe plugins structure.
